Summary: The HotpotQA dataset includes a total of 112,779 Wikipedia-based Q&A pairs split into several subsets: 18,089 train-easy, 56,814 train-medium, 15,661 train-hard, 7,405 dev, 7,405 test-distractor, and 7,405 test-fullwiki. The dataset focuses on hard multi-hop questions that challenge current modeling techniques. The test sets are designed to avoid information leakage, with the distractor setting providing gold paragraphs and the full wiki setting restricting access to them. The dataset is distributed under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
